title: Authorized Origin Allowlist
intent: Restrict collectors to pre-authorized origins and revalidate redirects.
problem: Without normalized scheme-host-port tuple is checked after every redirect, the system can accept an outcome that is not justified by the authorized origin allowlist contract.
context: This pattern addresses collection authority names exact web origins; its concrete control is normalized scheme-host-port tuple is checked after every redirect.
forces: Correctness requires that no request leaves approved origins
Operational pressure can cause: userinfo or port tricks alter origin parsing
solution: Implement normalized scheme-host-port tuple is checked after every redirect. Verify the anchored symbol `CandidateProvider` with `test_default_config_loads_boot_collection_policy` before reuse.
invariants: redirect destinations receive a fresh policy check
failure_modes: userinfo or port tricks alter origin parsing
DNS or redirect moves collection outside scope
security: The security boundary specifically rejects `userinfo or port tricks alter origin parsing` and fails closed if the authorized origin allowlist evidence cannot be verified.
privacy: For authorized origin allowlist, persist only its decision identifiers and digests; exclude payload data unrelated to normalized scheme-host-port tuple is checked after every redirect.
reuse_constraints: Confirm the target still requires: collection authority names exact web origins
Do not apply when: a local supplied file requires no network access
External Ethernian promotion signature remains mandatory
applies_when: collection authority names exact web origins
not_when: a local supplied file requires no network access
